verdict.rationale: Extend advertises a 'Fast mode' feature and has separate Async Processing docs, implying distinct sync/async processing paths, but no evidence quantifies latency (e.g., 'seconds') for either mode or documents a per-mode latency comparison. missing for 10: explicit latency numbers/benchmarks per mode, documentation showing synchronous mode designed for sub-second/seconds interactive use, independent confirmation of response times.
